title: Recover mechanical owner-origin drift without erasing its failed witness
failure_signature: The first x1 suite expected Sable's successor-origin label even though the generated v648-v6 packet correctly used Orin's owner label.
trigger_preconditions: A mechanically adapted successor test retains a predecessor owner token.
candidate_workaround: Correct only the owner-origin assertion to orin_v648_v6_new and rerun the bounded x1 suite.
recurrence_guard: Audit owner, slug, branch, and origin tokens independently after mechanical phase-number replacement.
rollback: Give the failing suite no pass credit, retain the mismatch, and keep the generated packet unchanged.
scope_boundary: Bounded owner-label correction only; no inherited evidence, authority, or completion credit.
